inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL string-function reference projects the final three characters of a literal with RIGHT.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one scalar suffix extraction plus NULL propagation with independently authored literals, preserving the RIGHT compatibility contract without copying the source example.

fixture_notes: A fixed label produces its final three characters, while a NULL argument remains NULL.
determinism_notes: Both scalar arguments are fixed and no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.

steps.sql: SELECT RIGHT('manifest-204', 3) AS suffix_text, RIGHT(NULL, 2) AS null_suffix
